summary: Shaw Downie is a Sydney CBD chartered accounting firm of about 10 people, founded in 2009 by Nick Shaw. It positions itself as an end-to-end finance and tax solution and acts as the outsourced finance department for local and foreign owned businesses, including month-end reporting, AP, AR and the inventory cycle.

claims.quote: Street Address: Level 3, 47 York St Sydney NSW 2000

claims.quote: Director - Shaw Downie Chartered Accountants (Current) Dec 2009 - Present

hooks.text: Nick calls himself an Outsourced Accounting Specialist and the firm runs clients' month-end, AP, AR and inventory cycle, so reconciling across many client ledgers is recurring load.
Foreign-owned subsidiary clients likely mean tight head-office reporting timetables.
Small team (about 10) growing, so automation lifts capacity without hiring.

risks.text: Firm site and LinkedIn show no sign of Xero/MYOB partner status or an AI reconciliation tool; tech stack unknown.

gaps: No recent posts, podcasts, news or job ads found for the firm or Nick.
Tech stack (Xero/MYOB/Dext) not found; LinkedIn lists only LastPass.
Jamcyber testimonial video page had no readable content.
